clues.it: Vito era nella 5ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e accanto a un salvagente, ma non era accanto a una sedia.
clues.en: Vito was in the 5th column, in the 1st row and beside a life ring, but was not beside a chair.

clues.it: Elena era a nord di Paolo e in Cambusa.
clues.en: Elena was north of Paolo and in the Galley.

clues.it: Irene era nella 7ª colonna e accanto a un barile o a un salvagente.
clues.en: Irene was in the 7th column and beside a barrel or a life ring.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 2ª colonna, nella 4ª riga e accanto a una corda, ma non era accanto a uno scaffale.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 2nd column, in the 4th row and beside a rope coil, but was not beside a shelf.

clues.it: Giada era nella 5ª riga e in Stiva, ma non era accanto a una pozza.
clues.en: Giada was in the 5th row and in the Hold, but was not beside a puddle.

clues.it: Dario era nella 6ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Vito.
clues.en: Dario was in the 6th row and in the same room as Vito.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Carla era accanto a un'ancora, ma non era accanto a una pozza.
clues.en: Carla was beside an anchor, but was not beside a puddle.

clues.it: Olga era nella 9ª riga, in una stanza diversa da Paolo e in Stiva.
clues.en: Olga was in the 9th row, in a different room from Paolo and in the Hold.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Vito lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Vito's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Irene lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Irene's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 7th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Paolo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 4ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Paolo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 2nd.

steps.it: Incrociando l'indizio di Dario con quelli già usati resta una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Cross-checking Dario's clue with the ones already used leaves a single square: row 6th, column 3rd.

steps.it: Irene può stare solo nella 7ª colonna: escludendola, a Giada resta una sola casella: riga 5ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Irene can only be in the 7th column: ruling it out leaves Giada a single square: row 5th, column 4th.

steps.it: Giada può stare solo nella 4ª colonna: escludendola, a Carla resta una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Giada can only be in the 4th column: ruling it out leaves Carla a single square: row 8th, column 8th.

steps.it: Giada può stare solo nella 4ª colonna: escludendola, a Olga resta una sola casella: riga 9ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Giada can only be in the 4th column: ruling it out leaves Olga a single square: row 9th, column 6th.

steps.it: Olga può stare solo nella 6ª colonna: escludendola, a Elena resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Olga can only be in the 6th column: ruling it out leaves Elena a single square: row 2nd, column 1st.

steps.it: Nessun altro può stare nella 9ª colonna, e lì a Ugo resta una sola casella libera: la 7ª riga.
steps.en: No one else can be in the 9th column, and it leaves Ugo a single free square there: the 7th row.
